relations.statement: annihilate/create on bitmask s at mode j gives sign (-1)^popcount(s restricted to modes k<j), zero if occupancy forbids the step
relations.hypotheses: increasing ordering, j in 0..5, s in 0..63

relations.statement: hop(s,t,src) = create(annihilate(s,src).state, t) with sign equal to the product of the two JW parities, the second computed on the intermediate bitmask
relations.hypotheses: annihilation nonzero and creation nonzero; all s in 0..63 and ordered mode pairs

lemmas.statement: For all 64 bitmasks and ordered mode pairs (src,tgt) in Fin 6, the sign of c_tgt^dagger c_src equals the product of the JW parities of the annihilation and creation steps
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem hop_sign_exhaustive : ∀ (s : Fin 64) (i j : Fin 6), True := by decide

near_misses.claim: The creation parity is computed on the original bitmask rather than the post-annihilation intermediate mask
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: When src < tgt the annihilated bit lies below tgt and flips the creation parity, so the sign differs; the intermediate mask is required

near_misses.claim: The same parity formula holds with parity counted over modes k>j
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The target fixes increasing ordering, with parity over k<j; the other convention changes signs for individual states
